entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who leads the assault on Voldaren Manor and chases Olivia, then is impaled by her.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire progenitor who flees through her manor, wounds Arlinn with a sword and strikes her down.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who follows his grandfather into the sanguitorium and loses their brutal fight.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, who fights him with contempt, defends Olivia and flings him into the pit.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who reaps vampire heads in the ballroom after being freed.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who frees the spirits of the manor and stabs Olivia's train.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer who burns down the great doors.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar who leads the charge on her warhorse.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who hastens the foot soldiers and burns the door hotter.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: The witch's spirit leading the geists and guiding Arlinn.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A werewolf whose urging Arlinn recalls and refuses to follow.

entities.name: Streak
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, whom she misses.

entities.name: Boulder
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, whom she misses.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, whom she misses.

entities.name: Redtooth
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, whom she misses.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel Sorin created, which Edgar calls his toy soldier.

entities.name: The geists of Voldaren Manor
entities.description: Hundreds of spirits of Olivia's victims who materialize and attack their oppressors.

entities.name: The assault force
entities.description: Cathars, priests, witches, archers and farmers who storm Voldaren Manor.

entities.name: Voldaren family
entities.description: Olivia's vampire house, whose guards and portraits fill the manor.

entities.name: Markov family
entities.description: Sorin's family, one of whose duelists attacks Arlinn.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key Arlinn is trying to retrieve and which Olivia has hidden in her train.

entities.name: Voldaren Manor
entities.description: Olivia's estate in Stensia, where the wedding takes place and the assault occurs.

entities.name: Sanguitorium
entities.description: The vat-filled blood stores of the Voldarens where Sorin and Edgar fight.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: The region of Innistrad where Voldaren Manor stands.

entities.name: Harvesttide Massacre
entities.description: The attack that Arlinn wants vengeance for.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose people fight for the day.

events.summary: A beam of light shatters Voldaren Manor's windows and the invitation wards crumble, and Arlinn orders the assault.
The assault force charges across the bridge, overwhelming the gate guards and downing swarms of bats with magic and arrows.
events.quote: As the bats descend, hungry for blood, the witches and archers are eager to meet them.

events.summary: Chandra and Teferi burn down the manor's great door, beginning the assault proper.
events.quote: soon the door before them is only ash

events.summary: Kaya senses angry spirits and hears Katilda calling, and goes to free the geists while Arlinn presses on.
events.quote: "I'll see about our backup. It's time the Voldarens paid their debts."

events.summary: The assault force tears through the guards and furnishings of the manor.
events.quote: Vampires built this place on the backs of mortals.

events.summary: Arlinn reaches the ballroom, sees Sigarda reaping vampires, and spares a Markov duelist rather than kill him as Tovolar would.
events.quote: Arlinn hefts him overhead and hurls him into a column.

events.summary: Cathars crash through the windows and the crowd demands the key; Olivia rages at the destruction of her wedding.
events.quote: "You . . . all of you! You're ruining my wedding day !"

events.summary: Hundreds of geists materialize and attack their former oppressors, led by Katilda.
events.quote: There must be hundreds of them, all materializing at once

events.summary: Kaya stabs Olivia's train, freeing the geists bound within it, and Olivia flees into a hallway.
events.quote: Kaya plunges a spectral dagger into Olivia's fell train.

events.summary: Sorin follows his grandfather into the sanguitorium and urges him to see Olivia is only using him.
events.quote: "Grandfather, you know this is foolish. She's only using you."

events.summary: Edgar breaks Sorin's wrist and throws him into a vat, accusing him of never being part of the family.
events.quote: Edgar catches Sorin's wrist, his fingers a vise.

events.summary: Sorin batters Edgar with an iron pipe, but Edgar insists he created Avacyn from his research and has squandered his gift.
events.quote: "Your little toy soldier? Yes, I'm aware."

events.summary: Edgar slams Sorin into a vat and he relives being forced to drink angel's blood at the family gathering.
Edgar throws Sorin into a great pit.
events.quote: And Sorin Markov continues to fall.

events.summary: Arlinn chases Olivia through the portrait-lined corridors and corners her in a dead end, where she claws her.
events.quote: With a human howl, she lashes out

events.summary: Olivia cuts Arlinn's fingers and stabs her chest with a gilt sword, taunting her for being alone.
Arlinn changes into her wolf form and fights Olivia, hurling her through a statue.
events.quote: Senses sharpen. Strength returns to her as she grows

events.summary: Distracted by tearing at the portraits, Arlinn is staked by Olivia from behind and falls.
events.quote: How ironic—a vampire's stiffened hand makes for an excellent stake.

relations.quote: "You are a child. You have always been a child," he intones.
" You ," Olivia sneers. "Why did you have to come?"
Kaya's hand on her shoulder brings her back to the present moment

relations.note: Katilda's spirit leads the geists and guides Arlinn.
relations.quote: And among the crowd, a familiar headdress stands out: Katilda.
The air in Stensia is bright and clear for the first time in what feels like months

relations.note: Arlinn trusts that Sorin will do the right thing.
